checks: Fresh saved ASM3ABD60/3ABD80 and38CF20 confirm independent break state and single-precision product; original break must not be recalculated on restore.
PairHandle preserves existing Sora/live-status/parameter-owner/game-thread/heartbeat/pin gates; validates six integral arguments, both finite bounded pairs and current default/product for apply.

Full-pair comparison precedes either write; apply mismatch rejects, restore mismatch is acknowledged no-op. No native call or yield between compare and stores. Four-byte alignment and no hardware64-bit CAS are explicit.
One snapshot publication supplies exact scale/break bits and native default; decoder requires fresh protocol4/capabilities/validity and rejects malformed or unrepresentable values.
Host cleanup intent is recorded before awaiting apply. Only received PairHandle pre-write codes2/3/4 or local prepublication control deferral clear it; timeout/unknown errors retain intent.
Actual received rejection conversion is preserved through MainViewModel and adapter; the foreign pair already equal to desired case no longer authorizes an accidental restore.

Restore sends original bit patterns even after default changes; successful mismatch settles cleanup. Lost ACK retains intent until acknowledged retry; no scalar sustain or approximate comparison remains for these rewards.
HasDurableCleanup exempts pending pair intent from the180-second abandonment cutoff without becoming an Actor lease or bypassing ordinary control gates.
A fresh foreign pair reaches Monitor before duration charge; unavailable pair/control pauses useful time even with ordinary timer-pause opt-out.
Ordinary bridge request/response sequencing blocks a new restore publication while the previous command remains outstanding.

acceptedLimits: Value equality cannot identify identical foreign writes or ABA across scene/process lifetimes; no native generation/journal is claimed.
Uncooperative external memory writers/page-protection races are outside game-thread serialization.

The tests are synthetic; this review did not reproduce live gameplay or rerun suites.
